questions.question: What will the wilderness and dry land do in Isaiah 35?
options: Dry up and crack under the burning sun
Be glad and blossom like a rose
Be filled with thorns and briers
Tremble and shake at the LORD's coming
questions.answer: Be glad and blossom like a rose

questions.question: What highway is described in Isaiah 35?
options: The long road down to Egypt, freshly paved for all the exiles
The Way of Holiness, on which the unclean shall not pass
The hidden path right through the sea, walled on each side with water
The great King's Highway, built strong for the royal chariots
questions.answer: The Way of Holiness, on which the unclean shall not pass

questions.question: Isaiah 35 says the eyes of the blind shall be opened and the ears of the deaf unstopped.
The wilderness and the dry land shall be glad; the desert shall rejoice and _____.
The redeemed of the LORD will return and enter Zion with singing, _____ with everlasting joy.
